title: incident-bot: oncall autodiagnostics + SLO toolkit helpers
author: Aisha Khan
description: Motivation: oncall teams requested richer SLO context and better runbook linking during incidents. This PR adds SLO toolkit helper endpoints and enriches autodiagnostics results with SLO metadata and confidence signals to improve runbook suggestions. Summary: 1) new enrichment pipeline that augments incident summaries with SLO name, owner, target, burn rate, and recent windowed error rate; 2) runbook-linking heuristics that use enriched SLO signals to rank candidate runbooks and present quick links to oncall; 3) a lightweight cache for SLO lookups to keep tail latency low; 4) feature flag and config knobs to enable enrichment per team; 5) tests and docs. Checklist: [x] implement enrichment pipeline [x] add runbook ranking heuristics [x] add metrics & tracing for SLO lookups [x] unit + integration tests [x] docs & console examples [x] feature flag gated rollout. Breaking changes: none. Rollout plan: enable per-team flag in staging for 48 hours, verify decrease in time-to-first-action in simulated incidents, then roll to production with 10% ramp for 24 hours and monitor SLO lookup latency and runbook click-through metrics. Migration: no DB migrations; cache schema is in-memory with optional Redis backend config documented.

release_notes: Adds SLO context enrichment and runbook helper endpoints to incident-bot. Improves runbook suggestion relevance using SLO signals, adds telemetry for SLO lookup latency, and includes a feature flag for staged rollout.
merge_outcome: Merged to main after approvals; no conflicts; feature gated behind per-team flag.
review_thread: Priya Sharma (reviewer): Nice work on the enrichment pipeline. A few nits: can we avoid blocking autodiag when SLO service is slow? Suggest fallback behavior.
Aisha Khan (author): Thanks Priya, added a non-blocking path and fallback to cached SLO summary; updated tests to cover slow responses.
Liam O'Connor (reviewer): Please add a metric for SLO lookup latency percentile and alert if 95th > 500ms. Also check RBAC for SLO endpoints.
Aisha Khan (author): Added latency histogram and an optional alert rule in observability examples; verified RBAC uses service token scope only.
Marco Diaz (reviewer): Integration test is failing intermittently on CI due to rate limit from SLO test fixture. Can we mock external service?
Aisha Khan (author): Reworked integration test to use local test harness and recorded fixture; reran CI and all checks passed.
ci_details: CI: unit tests passed on first run, integration flaky test fixed, full pipeline passed after rerun. Coverage: enrichment 88%, runbook ranker 92%.
notes_for_ops: Feature is behind feature flag incident.autodiag.slo_enrichment. Default: off. Ops should monitor slo_lookup_latency, runbook_link_click_rate, and autodiag_time_to_first_action. On rollback: disable feature flag and delete ephemeral cache on nodes.
summary_changes: This PR improves autodiagnostics by enriching incident context with SLO metadata and ranking runbooks based on SLO signals. Adds caching and telemetry to keep tail latency low while improving suggestion relevance.
